info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Sales Product Management API
info.description: The Sales Product Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and enhance their sales product offerings. This API allows users to create new sales products, providing critical details such as pricing, features, and descriptions. Typical users include sales teams and product managers who seek to streamline product onboarding and updates. With this API, organizations can maintain a robust catalog of sales products, adapt to market needs, and ultimately drive revenue growth.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new sales product in the system. It requires the product details to be specified in the request body, including the name, price, and description of the product. Upon a successful request, the newly created product will be returned.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new sales product. It should contain all necessary details about the product being created, following the specified schema.
